title: The Warden's Deep
pages:
Behind the monument there is a vault under the water.

Gold in barred rooms. He was afraid someone would take it.

The thing at the end is not a warden. It is the shape of one.

He put it there to keep out the one visitor he was afraid of. Me.

It let me through.

I do not know whether that means I was forgiven, or only recognized.
